//filesAnchor: 'File Explorer' and 'Document' both resolve to /files and were both proven by heading 'Shared with me' — the first heading the derivation happened to find. The flag that said so ('checkByEye') is GONE because the human look it asked for HAPPENED: on 2026-10-02 /files opens on the workspace view (breadcrumb Home > workspace, workspace tree, Folders/Documents cards) and there is no 'Shared with me' tab on it at all. The flag was right and its subject is now settled. Both entries use tree 'Workspaces', measured across the 10 capture sessions (58 non-empty /files states): present exactly once in every one of them, and at NO other route. Two candidates were measured and rejected: textbox 'Filter workspaces' is also at /upload-files and /bulk-upload, so it identifies no screen; button 'New workspace' is /files-only and would work, but creating a workspace is a privileged action and a user without that right may not see it, whereas the tree IS the view. KNOWN LIMIT: the capture is older than the application — all 58 states still show 'Shared with me' — so this is as good as a capture can make it, and /files is due a re-capture.
